name: IRIS RegTech Solutions Ltd
title: IRIS RegTech Solutions Ltd - 540735 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Software/RegTech call with no capacity or utilisation content; management guides INR500 crore revenue aspiration (~30% CAGR over 4-5 years), IRIS CARBON ARR growth ~35% target, and flags possible Middle East SupTech pipeline delay after June.

triggers.label: INR500 cr revenue aspiration reiterated
triggers.quote: In short, the target is INR500 crores, and we feel we are getting into a position

triggers.label: Middle East SupTech pipeline risk
triggers.quote: I wouldn't be surprised if there is some delay if this whole thing continues beyond a point.

guidance.quote: this will require a growth rate of slightly over 30%over the next 4 to 5 years
For our SaaS business, we are targeting an ARR growth rate of approximately 35%
I would say that 75 to 80 days is what we would be comfortable

red_flags.label: Middle East SupTech pipeline risk
red_flags.quote: it is possible that a prolonged Middle East crisis might have a possible adverse impact on the SupTech pipeline.

red_flags.label: Sales spend elevated for growth
red_flags.quote: We are well below the SaaS benchmarks where people spend at times more than $2 for $1 of net ARR. We are at about 1.1, 1.2 levels.

evasions.quote: we are setting the conditions for reaching this target
nothing is off the table, but we'll be disciplined
